en-US.title: The Loyalty Loop for Business
en-US.subtitle: Loyalty rewards for your shop
en-US.description:
The Loyalty Loop for Business is the easiest way to run a loyalty programme for your cafe, salon, bakery or shop - no card printer, no extra hardware.

RUN YOUR PROGRAMME
- Record a visit in seconds: scan the customer's QR code or type their code, then add their stamp or points
- Set your own rewards: "collect 8 stamps, get a free coffee", with bigger rewards at higher counts, or a points programme
- Let AI design a custom programme for you from a few plain-English answers
- Rewards catalogue and cash-off rewards, with a QR code for the customer to redeem
- Customers who use a linked payment card are earned automatically and clearly marked

MAKE IT YOURS
- Design your card: logo, colours, stamp icon, typography and layout
- Print your QR poster so customers can join at the till
- Pin your shop on the map so nearby shoppers find you, with your address, opening hours and description
- Walk-past offer: set a short offer shown to opted-in shoppers who pass your door, with counts of how many joined

KNOW WHAT WORKS
- Visits, repeat-visit rate, rewards and reviews in one view
- Reviews with AI-written replies you can approve, or post automatically for 4 and 5 star reviews
- Personalised AI coach: weekly wins, watch-outs and next steps
- Deep AI Business Report: summarise reviews, spot red flags and get growth ideas
- Ask Whirl, a friendly assistant for questions about your shop and data

KEEP IN TOUCH
- Send announcements and offers to your members
- Push notifications for scans, reviews and redemptions

TEAM AND SECURITY
- Add staff with their own permissions
- Shop verification, Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint app lock
- Home-screen scan widget, light, dark or match-your-phone appearance, and optional haptics
- Help and FAQ, contact support, and delete or hand over your shop at any time

Setup takes minutes - add your address, pin your location on the map, write a short description, and you're live to nearby shoppers.

Completely free to use, with no subscriptions, fees or in-app purchases.
en-US.releaseNotes: New in this version: new icons, light/dark/match-your-phone appearance, Ask Whirl, AI programme builder and review replies, walk-past offers for your shop, and a lot of polish.
en-US.promoText: Run a completely free digital loyalty programme in minutes. Record visits with a scan, reward customers for coming back, and get weekly AI coaching.
